lines.text: My friend, not a my friend!
Many learners say: He is a my friend.

native.tip: Türkçede “bir arkadaşım” deriz; İngilizcede “my” varken “a” gelmez.
native.caption: “He is a my friend” mi diyorsun? 😅 Doğrusu “He is my friend.” Carlos’u dinle ve tekrar et! Lexkite uygulamasını aç, daha çok pratik yap.
native.comment: Cevap: “my”. “My” varsa “a” gelmez. Ücretsiz testle pratik yap: {link}

en.tip: Do not put “a” before “my”: “He is my friend.”
en.caption: Do you say “He is a my friend”? 😅 English has no “a” before my. The right sentence is “He is my friend.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Open the Lexkite app and practice more.
